title: Mount Gretna Playhouse

services.name: Tickets
services.desc: All family series performances are general admission seating, first-come first-serve. Everyone must have a ticket to be seated-no babies in arms or kids on laps. Tickets can be printed at home, displayed on a mobile device, or picked up at the Box Office. Subscribers may exchange for another date of the same show for free. Individual Ticket buyers may exchange for another date of the same show for a $5 exchange fee, plus any applicable upgrade based on the cost of the new ticket. We do not offer refunds on tickets. blurb: One of the oldest summer theatres in America, Gretna Theatre is located in the arts/resort community of Mt. Gretna, PA where theatre has been produced at this same location since 1927!
